sections.hypothesis: Trend-vol-target on BTC, with its settings chosen on past data, beats holding BTC on Sharpe in most of the following test windows. This fills scorecard test 3 (out of sample) for the run graded on 2026-11-14.
sections.rationale: The scorecard (2026-11-14) grades out-of-sample by test window against holding, which the 2026-11-12 walk-forward did not record. That note (trend-following-robustness-and-walk-forward-btc) is rejected because ETH failed, so it can't run again. This note repeats the identical BTC walk-forward to record the per-window comparison. Written after its aggregate was seen (out-of-sample Sharpe 0.97 vs 0.71 for holding; return +111% vs +132%), but not the per-window results. The settings are identical, so it adds no trials, and the outcome is fixed by the data: this is a measurement, not a new try.
sections.rules: kestrel walk-forward BTCUSDT --strategy trend-vol-target --interval 1d --start 2020-01 --end 2025-10 --train-months 24 --test-months 6 --grid slow_days=90,120,180 --grid target_vol_pct=30,50,70 (7 folds, 9 grid points; other parameters at their defaults). Costs from kestrel.toml, 330 USDT. BTC only.
sections.falsification: Scorecard test 3 fails unless the strategy's Sharpe beats holding's in at least 4 of the 7 test windows (more than half). Run once. A fail is recorded on the scorecard and in research/decisions.toml; it does not change the other seven tests.
sections.parameters: Grid: slow_days 90/120/180 x target_vol_pct 30/50/70, with fast_days 20, mid_days 60, vol_days 30. Windows: 24 months training, 6 months test.
sections.costs: As before: about 22 bps a round trip. Every setting is identical to the 2026-11-12 study, so the trial count stays at 172.

history.reason: Failed its own rule (beat holding in 2 of 7 windows, 4 needed); recorded on trend-vol-target's pursue entry. Cleanup (Luke, 2026-11-15).
